author: vividamber
quote:
I am halfway through the game, and it's very boring. Doing chores for a virtual girlfriend and doing stuff that isn't fun, like going on a party on a yacht with her boring friends. 50% into the game and I haven't done a bank heist or something cool. It doesn't feel like a GTA game at all. Characters aren't memorable, they are boring and don't make funny jokes like they used to in previous games. The writing is consists of millenial humor or stuff that you don't really care about. Plus the performance isn't great.

Don't buy this game, it's really boring and bad. Truly the worst GTA ever.
